snippet.title: Phobos Down release gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam and Itch.io (Windows and Linux). More information: https://www.fractilegames.com/phobos-down/

Phobos Down is a twin stick shooter stripped down to the bare essentials. There is a player with three guns, swarms of enemies that need killing and a weapon upgrade system made as simple as possible. You can play unique randomized missions or weekly challenges where everyone plays the same game and competes for the highest scores.

This gameplay trailer has been clipped from a single 4+ minute mission gameplay recording on Steam Deck.
